items.label: 俄共（布）
items.prompt: Edit the complete Bolshevik adviser-faction icon in the reference. Remove the entire circular backing plate and ALL circular rings. The only silhouette must be a five-point red star with one large hammer and sickle placed over it. More serious and restrained 1930s political insignia, visually akin to hand-painted HOI4 Kaiserreich UI symbols and an aged printed metal stencil. Reduce the cartoon/game-loot badge feel drastically: NO glossy enamel, NO inflated bevels, NO chrome shine, NO thick shiny gold outlines, NO photorealistic jewelry. Use deep muted crimson, warm pale brass for the thick hammer and sickle, almost-black painted shadow planes, sparse dry-brush highlights at upper-left, fine restrained wear. Near-flat, angular forms with strong readable light-dark contrast. Very simple large shapes because the final icon will be only 20x20 pixels, not a richly decorated focus icon. Let the five star points provide an irregular uncluttered outer silhouette. No wreath, ring, border, ribbon, letters, portrait or scenery. Centered complete icon, 8% genuinely transparent margin, fully transparent background. Preserve recognizable hammer-and-sickle geometry. Deliver a single complete finished icon.
